about.metaDescription: Mind is the company behind InterMIND — technology for borderless conversation. EU intellectual-property holder (MindMeeting OÜ, Estonia) and UAE operational entity (Golden Fish CSP LLC, Dubai).
about.lede: Mind is the company behind InterMIND — technology for borderless conversation.
about.whoBody: Mind is a technology company building InterMIND: real-time multilingual communication that lets people work together across languages without losing meaning. This site is the company's front door — for partners, press, and anyone verifying who stands behind the product.
about.buildBody1: InterMIND lets everyone in a meeting speak and be understood in their own language, in real time. Instead of defaulting to a shared second-best language, each person keeps their own — and tone, nuance, and intent come through intact.
about.structureLead: Mind operates through two legal entities — intellectual property held in the EU, operations run from the UAE:
about.entityEuRole: EU entity — holds the intellectual property.
about.approach1: Verifiable over trust-us. Quality you can check against a public standard — not marketing claims.
about.approach2: Language shouldn't decide who you can work with. Borders and accents are not a filter on talent or opportunity.
about.approach3: Small team, AI-amplified. People lead the decisions; AI does the heavy lifting.
